disclaimers.confidence_semantics: The `confidence` field is a SUBJECTIVE EDITORIAL prior about how indicative a signal is when present. It is NOT a calibrated probability, NOT P(AI|signal), and was NOT derived from a labelled benchmark. Do not sum, multiply, or threshold these values as if they were probabilities. Any real deployment must re-estimate weights on a local, labelled corpus (see gaps/07).
disclaimers.non_native_fp_risk: Qualitative risk that this family raises false positives on English-as-a-second-language writers (see gaps/01). Editorial estimate.
disclaimers.text_length_sensitivity: Qualitative note on the minimum text length at which this family is trustworthy (see gaps/07). Editorial estimate.
disclaimers.estimated_half_life_months: Where present on a pattern: a HEURISTIC editorial estimate (not measured) of how long the signal stays useful before models/humanizers erode it (see gaps/08). Reflects observed lexical/format drift 2023 -> 2026.
